items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: He was, Harold Batiste was with Sonny and Sheriff on the one.

ctx.x: Well they tell me he writing for some big outfit in California now, you know, which you know, him and Melvin Batiste, Melvin Lestey, they had a recording studio, real, I mean, real well-equipped, yeah, right here in New Orleans. Do you remember that?
He was, Harold Batiste was with Sonny and Sheriff on the one.
